## Meetup Connector

Supported modes:

### 1. Meetup Pro GraphQL
Pass structured GraphQL event records through `graphqlEvents`.

Current official endpoint:
`https://api.meetup.com/gql-ext`

### 2. Email / Forward mode
Pass Meetup emails, Telegram/WhatsApp forwards, or manually copied event text.

Extracts:

- title
- start/end
- venue
- price
- event URL
- group name
- RSVP/attendee count
- category
- confidence

This workflow does not perform unauthorized scraping.

No AI credits are used.
